events.text: Root cause confirmed: delete part replaced the paint target without the atlas/program carry already used by append, then UV island rebuild remapped saved pixels. Unified paint-stable add/delete/hide/show plus undo/redo carry; 20 paint tests cover delete survivor and delete-last empty midpoint; ReleaseFast build passes.

resolution: Fixed the paint corruption at its structural target-replacement boundary: deleting, hiding, showing, adding, duplicating, or mirroring whole parts now carries exact atlas pixels plus the durable stroke program through the rebuild and through mesh undo/redo. Delete-last to an empty mesh preserves its carry for undo, while adding fresh geometry to an intentionally emptied document cannot resurrect old paint.
